newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 8.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 8.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Opposition parties slammed government plans to delegate Social Security Self-Government representatives as oppsoed to the present practice of electing them.
- State privatisation agency APV Rt cannot take responsibility for the losses suffered by Port Rt's investors.
- A worker of the Labatlan cement factory died when he was accidentally buried under gravel.
- Neutrality is no longer an option in the present world, Foreign Minister Laszlo Kovacs said during a lecture about Hungary's NATO and EU accession plans.
- Hungary continues to watch developments concerning a Russian law that on war loot, including artworks from Hungary, Foreign Ministry spokesman Gabor Szentivanyi said.
